_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi#5 -- both halves executed, one confirmed and one FALSIFIED. Confirmed: upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml defines a single SOLVER 1 block and points all four consumers (structure, fluid, ALE, monolithic FSI) at it; it runs to 'processor 0 finished normally' with OK (6) and 4C never remarks on the sharing, so per-field solvers are a preference and not a requirement. Falsified: the entry claimed a dangling LINEAR_SOLVER reference 'raises SOLVER N not found at setup'. Pointing ALE DYNAMIC at LINEAR_SOLVER: 7 with no SOLVER 7 block yields no 4C diagnostic at all -- no PROC 0 ERROR block, no MPI_ABORT banner, no mention of ALE DYNAMIC. Trilinos throws Teuchos::Exceptions::InvalidParameterName ('Error!  The parameter "SOLVER" does not exist in the parameter (sub)list "ROOT->SOLVER 7".') uncaught, std::terminate runs and the process dies on SIGABRT with exit status 134; the only pointer to the offending section is the mangled Adapter::AleBaseAlgorithm::setup_ale frame in the signal backtrace. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, git 89519cfe76).
